summary: Checked all five estimates against every cited PDF source page and read the complete markdown conversion, including references and editorial history. All recorded statistics, signs, arm assignments and analysis totals of 250 people match the paper. Arm-specific counts are not printed and remain null. Constructs, participant units and uncertainty basis, direction, immediate intervention-endpoint timing, between-person design and ai_vs_bau comparison are supported. Human external scoring is explicit, but the paper does not establish the lay/crowd versus expert rater subtype. The five reported problems are the unresolved required question codes: the PDF cannot establish AI availability during the scored survey response, so no replacement code is invented. No additional in-scope outcome or AI-arm contrast was identified in the supplied article. Exclusion of general supervisor-rated performance, self-reports, post-treatment-adjusted models, mediation and moderation is supported by the methods and results. The unadjusted novelty multilevel analysis is referenced without outcome-specific numerical results; it is already disclosed in not_extracted, and the same novelty contrast is represented by the t-test and condition correlation. The 14-page PDF has no appended supplement or embedded attachment. The local supplement manifest has no files. Independent requests to the printed supplement DOI and the Crossref API fallback both failed with WinError 10013. Completeness of the unavailable separate supplement could not be verified.
